root object [closed] [title: "Order"] [description: "A customer order."]
├─ orderId string [required] [read only] [format: uuid]
├─ status string [required] [enum: "pending" | "paid" | "shipped"]
├─ customer object [required] [closed]
│  ├─ name string [required] [1..80 chars]
│  ├─ email string [required] [format: email]
│  └─ loyaltyTier string | null [enum: "bronze" | "silver" | null]
├─ lineItems array [required] [>= 1 items]
│  └─ items object [closed]
│     ├─ sku string [required] [pattern: "^[A-Z0-9-]+$"]
│     ├─ quantity integer [required] [>= 1]
│     └─ unitPrice number [required] [>= 0] [multiple of 0.01]
├─ labels string[] [unique]
├─ deliveryWindow array [>= 2 items]
│  ├─ [0] string [format: date-time]
│  ├─ [1] string [format: date-time]
│  └─ additional items forbidden
├─ metadata object
│  └─ <other properties> string
└─ giftNote string | null [<= 200 chars]
